en: Multi-view postcard. The front shows a large stone building with a prominent light-blue dome in a historic cityscape, surrounded by red-roofed houses and hills in the background. Two interior views depict the same building's church-like nave with wooden pews, crucifix, altar, statues, and arched windows decorated with alternating red-and-white stone patterns reminiscent of former mosque architecture. The back is a standard divided postcard layout with multilingual caption identifying the site as the parish church of the city of Pécs.
